MOD = 1000000007

def qpow(x, n):
    ans = 1
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            ans = (ans * x) % MOD
        x = (x * x) % MOD
        n >>= 1
    return ans

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    if K == 0:
        print(qpow(P, P - 1))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(qpow(P, P))
        return
    vis = [False] * P
    p = 1
    cnt = 0
    while True:
        if vis[p]:
            break
        cnt += 1
        vis[p] = True
        p = (K * p) % P
    print(qpow(P, P // cnt))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
